column1: # Which keys SHOW an identity value (design-marathi §2.6). Read by GenTx into Masters.kt.
# Every key flagged erp-master or s5-master in strings-en.json is already in the map of its own
# family (room, site, job, article, articlekind, stage, workphase, work) without a line here.
# A line here ADDS a key to a map, for identity values whose key lives in another family. The map
# holds the key's ENGLISH byte for byte -> its accessor, so the English of each key below must be
# the stored value exactly; two keys with one English in one map are refused (no second answer).
# QuoteStage.STAGES: the six quote stages, S5's QUOTE_STAGES.
# Album.WORKS: the two of S5's sixteen works whose key is not a work.* key.
# Album.STAGE_WORK: the one worksite stage whose key is not a stage.* key.
# FlatPresets: "Other" is both a site type and a room.
# The default site's name, and the no-site bucket's (port 61c slice M2, with its reader, Catalogue.NO_SITE).
# The client folder of an S5 project nobody named a customer for (S5Masters.NO_CLIENT), the row L2's
# comment promised to M6, landed with its readers (port 61c slice M6): the crumbs, the search hits,
# the project sheet, the hero card and the queue subtitles show a client through Masters.client_name.
# WishList.SERVICES names (CCTV is an abbreviation and is shown as written).
# WishList.SERVICES descriptions. The plumbing one's key landed in port 61c slice L2
# (wish.water_drain_points_taps) and its row here with its reader, WishList.detail (port M4).
# SurveyPrep.TYPES: the mark types by name. Step is the floor's S.
# SurveyPrepPalette.SHORT: a type's name on its slot and its More tile.
# SurveyPrep.TAB and Handover.FACE_LABELS: a face tab's name (Top and Bottom are export-only, English).
# SurveyPlan.DTITLE: a drawing's full name (the chips' aria, the export aria, Drawing.title). view.ceiling_plan
# ("Ceiling plan") is deliberately NOT here: no DTITLE value says that -- the ceiling drawing is the REFLECTED plan.
